events.title: Steam Next Fest Community Event - WIN 3 BETA + FULL GAME KEYS
events.summary: Hello everyone!Steam Next Fest is LIVE, and we need your help to make Rescue Ops: Wildfire shine 🔥Want to help more people discover the game? Here's how you can support us during Next Fest:Download and play the demo!Leave an honest Steam review and share your experience.Spread the word and tell your friends about the game.(BONUS) Get your favorite streamer to give it a try!🚨 The first 3 days of Next Fest are especially important, so if you've been meaning to try the demo, now's the perfect time.

events.title: Demo is now LIVE

Feel free to join us there to share your content and feedback, chat with the team, or find other players to team up with.Thank you for your patience and for all your support. Have fun!❤️ Rescue Ops: Wildfire Team

events.title: 1 year since the game reveal & 100 000 wishlists
events.summary: Hi everyone!On May 13th, 2025, we officially revealed Rescue Ops: Wildfire to the world with our Reveal Trailer.One year later, we’ve officially passed 100,000 wishlists on Steam. Here is a quick recap of this incredible year:100,000 Steam wishlists45,000 players in our first public playtest4,300 Discord membersA successfully funded Kickstarter campaignThe whole Exkee team wants to sincerely thank you for your support, feedback, and enthusiasm since day one.Next stop: Alpha!❤️ Rescue Ops: Wildfi
